sources.description: Issuer names a successor and a conversion deadline; a policy assertion, not execution or entitlement evidence.

Public first-party FAQ application data says post-IPO conversion can be onchain without KYC. It also describes offchain arbitrage; it supplies no concrete audited conversion instruction in this captured source.

2025-08-07 issuer newsletter distinguishes KYC-gated mint/redemption from ordinary trading. General historical communication does not establish this holder eligibility or a currently functioning redemption flow.

Finalized bytes of source/successor mints and source authority; five recent signatures and one transaction per authority/successor. Limited observations are not exhaustive absence or signed inclusion proofs.

Issuer pages/FAQ captured read-only; X page returned 403 via browsing, syndication returned empty object; no post text is assumed. No issuer authentication, entitlement or backend access was obtained.

facts: Issuer notice links SPCXx mint Xs3oZwbHvqis4NYcf4YKWmEia2eC84wSiVrcYcTqpH8 and allows swapping into it or any other token before its stated deadline.
Issuer FAQ describes post-IPO conversion as fully onchain without KYC.

Source and published successor exist as non-executable Token-2022 mints at finalized slot 448024657. Source mint/freeze/permanent delegate authority is WV9PJN7XTmTLVwbutCLFxp8TyePee6Xq5mRq6Fti5Wc; captured authority account is empty System-owned, not itself a conversion program.

Sample source-authority transaction invokes Squads and withdraws withheld token fees; sample successor transaction contains token transfers. Neither sampled transaction establishes an official transition for this entity.
Bounded investigation: 6 address queries, 90 returned signature entries, 31 unique transactions, 31 available, 18 retry requests. No official executor established.
paths.reason: No independently verifiable official transition mechanism was established within the bounded investigation.
limitations: No verified conversion instruction/account plan or successor execution fixture was supplied.
Generic Burn/MintTo and administrative authority or fee-withdrawal instructions do not establish successor exchange, issuer authorization or redemption.
Bounded research cannot prove that no other onchain transition mechanism exists.
The existing USDC swap is SecondaryMarketExit evidence only; issuer wording does not automatically reclassify it as OfficialTransition proof.

Observed DEX routes, source burn/closure, successor MintTo and fee administration are not independently bound official conversion evidence. Unknown eligibility is not evidence of an actual KYC/backend dependency.

facts: Issuer historical launch communication says minting/redemption require KYC.
Current FAQ describes offchain exposure/arbitrage but supplies no holder-executable redemption instruction in the captured material.
No verified redemption program, payout guarantee or holder entitlement was established by the bounded transaction sample.
paths.reason: Unsupported: no independently verified redemption executor is available in the supported evidence boundary; issuer onboarding/KYC, backend and offchain exposure/entitlement are unavailable.
limitations: Unsupported means Eplyx cannot independently execute/verify the mechanism, not that redemption does not exist.
Historical generic issuer language is not proof of this holder current entitlement or eligibility.
Neither DEX output, Transfer nor a token Burn instruction proves redemption.

facts: Execution proof comes exclusively from exact Phase 7 holder/pool/amount results, hash-checked and fresh-replayed.
paths.reason: No new market context is inferred without exact execution evidence.
limitations: Only listed exact amounts, source state and pool are tested.
No continuous amount interval, future liquidity, other holder/venue, issuer transition or redemption is proven.

facts: Proof uses the real observed Phase 7 recipient and deployed Token-2022 program.
paths.reason: Only exact independently replayed transfer evidence can prove this path.
limitations: Locally assumed original owner signing establishes no real-world authorization.
Transfer is token movement, not sale, redemption or official successor conversion.

facts: Applicability depends on the selected entity context, not the existence of a venue vault.
paths.reason: Protocol/LP ownership and a withdrawal mechanism would require separate entity-level evidence.
limitations: Direct wallet-compatible holder with no verified protocol/LP role has no applicable Withdrawal in this entity context.
Protocol vault existence does not establish LP ownership or holder withdrawal rights.

investigation_scope: Exactly one Phase 7 source selected; no horizontal sampling or new venue execution.
First-party issuer notice, FAQ application chunk, historical launch newsletter and public metadata reviewed.
Three finalized accounts inspected; at most five signatures and one parsed transaction per source authority/successor.
No authenticated issuer workflow, legal entitlement, KYC/private state, full historical scan or successor execution obtained.
Absent discovery in this bounded scope is not evidence of global non-existence.
